summary: Foundation layer complete. PM + Verifier skills authored with full activation triggers, procedures, envelopes, rules. Sprint methodology codified. 9 sprint plans drafted, each with machine-checkable acceptance criteria. Verifier dry-run passed all criteria.
lessons: Codifying acceptance criteria up-front lets Verifier run mechanically — no judgment needed beyond what's already written.
Sprint plans serve double duty: PM uses them as a dispatch manifest; Verifier uses them as a checklist.
